_comment: Tinker pricing in $ per million tokens {prefill, sample, train}. Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B: published rates from https://tinker-docs.thinkingmachines.ai/tinker/models.json (checked 2026-10-07; 64K context). Costs are a list-price estimate for the tokens we count, excluding cached-prefill discounts ($0.372 published) and any unobserved billed work (e.g. failed, retried or cancelled calls): not an invoice. Runs started before the 8b1b381 pricing update recorded estimates at provisional rates (1.24/3.73/3.73) and are labelled as such. Other models: ported from reward-laundering/pricing/tinker.json (published 2026-07-02).
